document.abstract: This standard specifies the basic system parameters, i.e., the positions of recording head gaps, the scanning configuration, the axis of rotation of the video head wheel, and the appropriate tape tension for 1-in type B helical-scan television tape recorders for 525/60 monochrome or NTSC color systems.
